title: Mixed Event — Secret Operation Valentine's Day — Episode1 The Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!

meta.Episode: Episode1 — The Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!
meta.Event Outline: With Valentine's Day just on the horizon, Airi is planning a surprise for everyone to show them her gratitude. She happens to meet Saki and Emu, who both had similar ideas, and they form a Secret Valentine's Day Alliance.

rows.Line: Lunch Break
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Phew... There's way less people here. This should be a good spot for me to sit and think.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (It's about time I came up with a good Valentine's Day surprise.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Just giving out chocolates would be pretty bland too. What would be more fun and interesting...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... I'm not really sure...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Humhumhuuum♪
How can I make Valentine's Day with Ichi and the others fun...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I tried surprising them with chocolates from that really famous shop last time, but some of us ended up getting the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I've gotta find a way to make sure my plan succeeds this year!)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But how...? What should I do...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Something original...
Something that no one else would think of...)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh...
It's almost Valentine's Day!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We did a really amazing show last year, which was super duper fun♪

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Maybe I can ask Nene and the others to help out with another one this year☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But I kinda want to surprise them and put big smiles on their faces...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I know☆ What if I made some special and wonderhoy sweets that can make anyone smile?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Like shiny star cookies or chocolate robots that go cling-clang...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, I could even make a show stage using them☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
But how would I actually do that?
I'd have to melt a lot of chocolate, cool them using a really big refrigerator and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Chocolates? Chocolate-flavored sweets? Which would be better...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hmm!

rows.Speaker: Emu & Saki
rows.Line: Owwy!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
A-Are you two alright?!
That was a pretty nasty collision...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
A-Airi!
I'm okay!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I apologize for bumping into you like that. I was thinking about something and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I'm sorry too!
I was looking elsewhere and...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: H-Huh?! Saki, it's you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Emu!
I'm so sorry! Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yup! I'm more than okay!
Thank goodness you weren't hurt either, Saki♪

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm glad it wasn't anything serious.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Me too! Thank you very much for your concern!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hm? I swear I've seen her before somewhere... But where...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
This is Airi Momoi the idol!
AKA Happy Everyday!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-Wow! It's really Airi...!
You used to do the lion dance every morning on that one show!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
The Lion Mu-Mu-Music Battalion♪
Let's all do the carnivore ☆ dance!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you used to watch Morning Kids Station?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yeah! I really loved your lion dance!

rows.Speaker: Airi & Emu
rows.Line: Let's all do the carnivore dance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Whoa! The real lion dance!
Just the way I remember it too!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's just my way of thanking you for being such a dedicated viewer. Let's dance together again sometime!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay☆
Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're really the best, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: By the way, you two both mentioned that you were thinking about something. Mind if I ask what?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, about that!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: It's almost Valentine's Day, so I was trying to come up with a good way to surprise my friends...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?
You were trying to think of a surprise too, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Wait, Emu, you too?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, what a coincidence.
Hehe. I was trying to think of one just now as well!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You too, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I guess it sorta just means everyone has the same thing on their minds this time of year.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, mind telling me what you've come up with so far? We can have a little discussion while we eat too.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
L-Lunch with Airi...?!
Y-Yes, I'd love to!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, who do you two plan on surprising this year?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: My goal's to knock the socks off of my bandmates and my brother with a really big surprise!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! Me too!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Everyone who does shows with me, my big brothers, Mr. Mascot, Sakurako and Miku... I mean, all of my friends...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Th-That's a lot of people!
Also, shows...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup! We do shows at Phoenix Wonderland's Wonder Stage!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And my big brother's been performing in shows with Emu because they're in the same troupe!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Really? Small world, huh?
Wait, Phoenix Wonderland...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, I saw that night show the last time I went!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
You did?!
Everyone from the Wonder Stage and I actually came up with that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: I'm so happy that you got to see it too, Airi☆

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
W-Wait, I'm so sorry!
I should be calling you by your last name!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. I don't really mind either way.
You can call me by my first name!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thank you, Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. You're so adorable.
I'm glad we met, Otori!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: C-Can I ask you to call me by my first name as well?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sure. Emu, right?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoa! Yes, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Emu, I'm so jealous...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That goes for you too, Saki, okay?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Airi..!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I promise to be your fan forever and ever and ever!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Haha. Thanks!
As your senior, I promise to look after you as well. I mean, you two are just too cute to ignore.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, it's clear that you both want to surprise the people who've been there for you... So what's giving you two such a headache?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I see...
Saki, you're wondering how to actually surprise everyone, while Emu doesn't know how to make her gifts.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I wanna make some shiny star cookies, chocolate robots and a cake that looks like a show stage!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Because I'm betting that everyone from the Wonder Stage is gonna smile from ear to ear if I make it right!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That sounds like a wonderful gift!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe...!
I'm just hoping that I can actually make it right...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yeah, that does sound challenging...
Have you ever made anything like this before, Emu?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Yup, my big sis and I tried making some when I was little! But it didn't go very well...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: We used all these yummy ingredients and even made it really colorful, but everything went all bo-boing for some reason once we were finished.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I think I get the gist of what you're trying to say...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
*Sob*
What if I'm just not cut out for making my own chocolates?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
No, don't say that!
It might not have gone well back then, but I'm sure you'll succeed if you try now!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
I know, Emu!
Why don't we try making some together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: You and me, Saki?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yup. Your story convinced me that I should bake some homemade chocolates for Ichi and the others too!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But I'm not sure how well that's gonna go...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Their friends must mean so much to them...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (As an idol, as well as their senior, I can't just sit idly by...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Saki, Emu, mind if I joined you on your culinary quest...?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Y-You'll help us, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course. I've never made anything that big before, but we can use what I've made in the past as a reference.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This'll be perfect too since I was also thinking about doing something for everyone in MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yay!
Thank you so much, Airi!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yeah, I have a feeling we can make anything as long as we have you on our side!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Then, we're in agreement.
This will be our Secret Valentine's Day Alliance!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
A secret alliance...!
Hehe. I can't wait to see what we end up making.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Me neither!
Let's bake something that'll really knock everyone's socks off!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, let's make it so our Valentine's Day surprise becomes a huge success!
